original: WPRPLACE (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈsɛljaˌlansˌfɔsː] ) is a waterfall in Iceland. WPRPLACE is located in the South Region in Iceland right by Route 1 and the road that leads to Þórsmörk Road 249. The waterfall drops 60 m and is part of the Seljalands River that has its origin in the volcano glacier Eyjafjallajökull. Visitors can walk behind the falls into a small cave.
